mostWorthwhile.text: Adding ribosomes was most worthwhile because the result connected copied instructions to making proteins, clarifying a relationship between cell parts.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the cell fluid was predictable, and its result added little explanation beyond the picture description.

surprise.text: The copied strips passing through nuclear pores made me think about how instructions leave the nucleus; the later ribosome explanation clarified what happens to them.

arbitrary.text: No action felt clearly arbitrary: the goals and named slots gave each part a purpose. The nuclei's role was initially less clear until the later ribosome explanation.

continue.text: I would probably try another chapter to see how the fibers become tissue and contribute to body movement. The cell-part explanations were useful, though the repeated fittings became predictable.
